action_brief: Read through the ChatGPT response detailing tools and workflows for drawing scientific architecture diagrams
environment: The full chat history is displayed: the user prompt asks for advice on drawing clean, simple scientific architecture and framework diagrams ('类似这种漂亮简单的科研线框示意图，架构图，怎么画，搜索blog，论文，twitter经验贴回答。例如在什么网站，或者用什么格式，基础形状是什么'). The detailed AI response explains diagram construction principles (vector flowcharts, modular stacked blocks, residual Add & Norm connections), practical multi-tool workflows (draw.io / Figma for drafting, Inkscape / Illustrator for vector refinement, TikZ for formula-heavy native LaTeX integration), and references tools/libraries such as AutomaTikZ, DeTikZify, PlotNeuralNet, and NNTikZ.
text_visible: 类似这种漂亮简单的科研线框示意图，架构图，怎么画，搜索blog，论文，twitter经验贴回答。例如在什么网站，或者用什么格式，基础形状是什么
最核心的不是'画画'而是'矢量流程图 + 少量自定义形状 + 严格对齐'
Transformer图是论文里典型的 encoder-decoder block diagram，结构由 stacked blocks、attention/feed-forward 子模块、残差 Add & Norm 连接构成
先用 diagrams.net/draw.io 或 Figma 快速排版，导出 SVG；再用 Inkscape/Illustrator / Affinity Designer 做精修；最后导出 PDF/EPS/SVG 放进论文
保留可编辑源文件；Inkscape 是免费矢量编辑器，适合科研图，矢量图缩放不糊；Scientific Inkscape 这类扩展还能做统一字体、线宽、批量导出等科研图工作流
如果你写 LaTeX 论文，图里有大量公式，TikZ 是最'论文原生'的方案。TikZ/PGF 本来就是 LaTeX 里的矢量绘图系统
实际工作流我建议这样选：简单模型架构图，用draw.io/Figma；需要投稿级矢量精修，用 draw.io/Figma 起稿+Inkscape 精修；只有当公式特别多或需要可复现时，才直接上TikZ
AutomaTikZ用TikZ作为 scientific vector graphics 的中间表示，DeTikZify 则尝试从草图/已有图恢复 TikZ 程序

action: I look at a photo post feed on my phone screen while seated on the subway train.
environment: Physical space: Inside a well-lit subway train carriage with blue speckled flooring and curved metal handrails. On the opposite bench row (red seats), three passengers are seated: one wearing a black top and jeans looking at a phone, one in a blue-and-white striped polo shirt and jeans looking at a phone, and one in an orange t-shirt holding a black canvas tote bag with white text reading '日常 電子 www.ltech.com.hk'. Beside me to the left sits a woman with dark hair wearing a yellow-and-white striped t-shirt and white shorts. Objects: I hold a black-cased iPhone with both hands. Screen content: The phone screen displays an image browsing feed with multiple travel and resort scenery photo tiles (one note caption mentioning '在国内没有对手 day2'). Ambient audio: Subway train rumbling.
details: I hold the phone with both hands while glancing over the image cards.

action: I swipe up to exit to the iOS App Library / home screen and say 'Bilibili.'
environment: The phone screen exits the browsing app and displays the iOS App Library grid with app category folders (Social, Utilities, Shopping) and search bar 'App 资源库'.
details: I speak out the app name as I prepare to search for it.

action: I open Spotlight search, clear 'gaode', type 'bili' into the search box, and tap the '哔哩哔哩' app icon.
environment: Spotlight search opens showing previous query 'gaode' and GaoDe Maps results, which is cleared; typing 'bili' displays '哔哩哔哩' in top search results. Tapping it opens Bilibili to a Dragon Boat Festival splash screen featuring '端午安康' with a green sachet illustration.
details: I use my right thumb to type on the keyboard and tap the Bilibili app icon.

action: As Bilibili opens with default prompt '亚马尔', I tap the top search bar, type 'chong zuo', and select '崇左'.
environment: The Bilibili homepage feed loads briefly with default search prompt '亚马尔' and recommendation tiles, then switches to the search input screen. Autocomplete suggestions for 'chong zuo' appear: '崇左', '崇左旅游攻略', '崇左丽世', '崇左秘境丽世度假村', '崇左美食', '崇左攻略', '崇左明仕田园', '崇左市', '崇左越南一日游', '崇左演唱会'. details: I type Pinyin 'chongzuo' with my right thumb and tap the top suggestion '崇左'.

action: I view the search results page in Bilibili listing travel vlog videos about Chongzuo.
